name: 4900P (datasheet)
reference: MG Chemicals 4900P TDS v4.0, 2025-10-02, reflow profile chart
notes: Digitised from the chart in the manufacturer's datasheet, read at the 30 s gridlines; temperatures are good to a few degrees, no better. The datasheet states the preheat rate must not exceed 2.5 C/s. CAUTION: as drawn, this curve spends only about 20 s above the 217 C liquidus, far short of the 60-150 s that J-STD-020 expects. The chart is drawn for a forced-air convection oven with at least 8 zones and appears schematic. Do not treat its peak region as precise. See docs for the open question.
